title: 第3章 令人咋舌的新手大礼包第4章 毒士出世
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
就如原身所处的大萧皇朝，在这广袤无垠的乾坤大陆上，宛如庞然大物，称霸一方，占据着辽阔的土地和众多的人口，光是人口就是以万万亿为单位。
然而，根骨资质能达天级者，犹如凤毛麟角一般，稀缺至极，有时甚至多年都难以出现一个根骨资质达到天级的少年英才。
更遑论是那达到天级上等的最高级别武道根骨资质了，整个大陆上最近一个拥有如此根骨资质的人，还需追溯至上百年前。
“哎！”这原身竟然还有一个副业：阵法师！在这片大陆上，为了更好地服务于武者，衍生出了众多的副职业，它们通常由武者构成，普通人要想成为其中一员，可谓难如登天。
诸如丹师、阵法师、傀儡师等。
“这原主修炼的功法‘九天玉鼎功’，已然达到了天级上品，在这片大陆上也堪称最顶级功法，它亦是大萧皇朝皇室的传承功法，唯有大萧皇朝的嫡系子弟方可修炼。
（注：这个世界的功法从低到高分为：不入流、黄级、玄级、地级、天级等，每个等级又细分为下品、中品、上品……）”
接着，萧凡大致浏览了一遍，除了手下和势力一栏略显空荡之外，其他的数据着实令人眼前一亮。
这也让萧凡如释重负，
他对废材逆袭的套路可不是太感冒，
如此一来，实在轻松不少！
随即，他关闭了个人消息数据面板。
……
突然，
脑海中传来了诸天争霸系统的声音，
【叮咚！发布长期任务：宿主需完成统一乾坤大陆的伟业！】，
【奖励：100亿诸天交易点，其他奖励未知！】，
......
【叮咚！发布临时任务：请宿主查出给宿主下毒的背后之人！】，
【奖励：1000诸天交易点，白银五十万两】，

萧凡心中暗自嘀咕，“这系统可真是不一般啊！竟然如此慷慨地抛出这么一张诱人的大饼，还真是令人心驰神往！”
“不过，还是得一步一个脚印地来！”
萧凡将其他模块逐一点开，粗略地浏览了一遍，
时间过去了将近一盏茶的工夫，
诸天争霸系统却宛如卡壳了一般，毫无动静！
萧凡终于按捺不住，高声呼唤道，“筒子！筒子！”
只听一道清脆的萝莉声传来，“主人！我在呢！有什么事要吩咐吗？”
这简直就是“你不开口，我就装傻，我装死到底！”
看到筒子那副无赖的样子，
萧凡不禁怀疑，这还是他所认识的那个声音甜美的筒子吗？
萧凡也懒得和它兜圈子，开门见山地问道，“筒子！主人的新手大礼包呢？是不是被你私吞了。”
系统的萝莉声稍稍沉默了片刻，随后慢悠悠地说道，‘嘻嘻！主人可真会开玩笑，筒子怎么会贪污主人的新手大礼包呢？
诸天争霸系统刚刚和主人完成绑定，正在努力适应这方世界呢？
请主人稍等片刻，新手大礼包马上就会发放！’
【叮咚！新手大礼包一份？】，
【已发放！】，
content_en:
Just like the Great Xiao Dynasty where it originally lived, it was like a behemoth dominating the vast Qiankun Continent, occupying a vast land and a large population. The population alone was measured in trillions.
However, those who have the talent to reach the heavenly level are as rare as a rare thing. They are extremely scarce. Sometimes it is difficult to find a young talent with the talent to reach the heavenly level even for many years.
Not to mention the highest level of martial arts qualifications that have reached the heaven level. The last person on the entire continent who had such basic qualifications had to go back hundreds of years.
"Hey!" This original person actually has a side job: array mage! On this continent, in order to better serve warriors, many sub-professions have been derived. They are usually composed of warriors. It is difficult for ordinary people to become one of them.
Such as Alchemist, Formation Master, Puppet Master, etc.
“The ‘Nine Heavens Jade Cauldron Technique’ practiced by the original master has reached the top level of the heavenly level, and is also considered the top-level technique on this continent. It is also an inherited technique of the Great Xiao Dynasty’s royal family, and can only be practiced by the direct descendants of the Great Xiao Dynasty.
(Note: From low to high, the skills in this world are divided into: unqualified, yellow, mysterious, earth, heaven, etc., and each level is further subdivided into low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade...)"
Then, Xiao Fan took a rough look at it. Except for the columns of subordinates and forces that were slightly empty, the other data was really eye-catching.
This also made Xiao Fan feel relieved,
He's not too fond of the waste material's counterattack routine.
This way, it’s really much easier!
Immediately, he closed the personal message data panel.
…
suddenly,
The voice of the Heavenly Struggle System came to my mind,
[Ding dong! Release a long-term mission: The host needs to complete the great cause of unifying the universe! ],
[Reward: 10 billion Heavenly Trading Points, other rewards are unknown! ],
...
[Ding dong! Issue a temporary task: Ask the host to find out the person behind poisoning the host! ],
[Reward: 1,000 Zhutian Trading Points, 500,000 taels of silver],
Xiao Fan secretly muttered in his heart, "This system is really extraordinary! It is really fascinating to be able to throw out such an attractive pie so generously!"
"However, we still have to do it step by step!"
Xiao Fan clicked on the other modules one by one and browsed them roughly.
Time has passed for nearly a cup of tea,
The system of the Battle for Hegemony in the Heavens seems to be stuck, with no movement at all!
Xiao Fan finally couldn't hold it any longer and shouted loudly, "Zongzi! Zongzi!"
I heard a crisp loli voice, "Master! I'm here! Do you have anything to tell me?"
This is simply "If you don't speak, I will pretend to be stupid, and I will pretend to be dead until the end!"
Seeing Tongzi’s rogue look,
Xiao Fan couldn't help but wonder, was this still the sweet-sounding person he knew?
Xiao Fan was too lazy to talk around with it and asked straight to the point, "Zongzi! Where is the master's novice gift bag? Did you steal it for yourself?"
The system's lolita voice was silent for a moment, and then said slowly, 'Hehe! The master is really good at joking. How could Zongzi embezzle the master’s novice gift package?
The Hegemony System has just been bound to its master. Are you trying to adapt to this world?
Master, please wait a moment, the newbie gift package will be distributed soon! ’
[Ding dong! A gift package for newbies? ],
【Distributed! ],
